title: Invertibility of the glued rationalization
statement: Let X be a scheme, J its pro-etale topology, R and S sheaves of commutative rings on J, a : R → S a ring-sheaf morphism, and L an S-module sheaf. An integral lattice pair on U consists of a finite locally free R|U-module P and a specified isomorphism S|U ⊗ P ≅ L|U, with the sheafified tensor product. Suppose the coefficient map is injective on every slice test object, r covers U, and x is a compatible family of represented lattice image families on r. Let M be the explicit compatible-tuple module and e its glued embedding, as constructed in the preceding node. Then the constructed morphism q : S|U ⊗ M → L|U induced by e is an isomorphism. [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-glued-rationalization, lem-weil-pbc-lattice-pair-restriction].

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; Descent and an exact presentation of lattice classes

proof.text: Use the tuple projection and invertible slice tensor comparison to identify the restriction with the given local rationalization. Check equality on unit tensors using the embedding formula and the existing latticeExtension_unit theorem from LatticeSheafBasic, then use the two adjunctions. Apply the local criterion for sheaf isomorphisms and reflect to module sheaves.

theorem gluedLatticeRationalization_isIso
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {R S : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (a : R ⟶ S)
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj S))
    (ha : ∀ (U : X.ProEt) T,
      Function.Injective (((latticeScalarMap a U).hom.app T).hom))
    (U : X.ProEt) (r : Sieve U) (hr : r ∈ (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) U)
    (x : Presieve.FamilyOfElements (latticeClassPresheaf a L) r.arrows)
    (hx : x.Compatible) :
    IsIso (gluedLatticeRationalization a L U ha r x hx hr)
